items.title: Fake GrubHub emails promise tenfold return on sent cryptocurrency
items.description: Grubhub users received fraudulent messages, apparently from a company email address, promising a tenfold bitcoin payout in return for a transfer to a specified wallet. [...]

items.title: Trust Wallet confirms extension hack led to $7 million crypto theft
items.description: Several users of the Trust Wallet Chrome extension report having their cryptocurrency wallets drained after installing a compromised extension update released on December 24, prompting an urgent response from the company and warnings to affected users. Simultaneously, BleepingComputer observed a phishing domain launched by hackers. [...]
